I then extracted the NFHL S_FLD_HAZ_AR polygons with SFHA_TF = 'T' and ran a point-in-polygon intersect in QGIS, which returned 11 hospitals. Of those 11, 3 are flagged CLOSED in the HIFLD status field, so 8 are flagged OPEN; the count of 11 covers all records as published.
